references.title: Promotion and trial invitation FAQ
references.description: Eligibility rules and limitations; not a redeemable offer for everyone.

references.title: Avoid double subscriptions
references.description: Check your original purchase platform before subscribing again.

offers.title: ChatGPT Plus: one year for eligible U.S. military transition
offers.benefit: One free year of ChatGPT Plus after eligibility verification
offers.eligibility: Verified U.S. veterans/retirees separated within past 12 months or active service members transitioning within next 12 months; ID.me verification and eligible personal ChatGPT account required.
offers.billing_note: Eligibility must be verified via ID.me; check subscription renewal terms in ChatGPT.

offers.title: Codex for Students: $100 usage credits (not a Plus subscription)
offers.benefit: $100 / 2,500 credits for Codex usage in ChatGPT (not API credits)
offers.eligibility: Verified university student at an eligible U.S. or Canadian institution, resident in an eligible country; requires SheerID verification and a ChatGPT account.
offers.billing_note: Codex usage credits are not ChatGPT Plus, API credits, or a recurring free plan.

offers.title: ChatGPT for Teachers: free for eligible U.S. K–12 educators
offers.benefit: ChatGPT for Teachers plan free through June 2028 (not a Plus or Pro subscription)
offers.eligibility: Teachers, staff and school leaders at eligible accredited U.S. K–12 schools/districts; institutional verification required, not for students.
offers.billing_note: Institutional plan benefit, not an individual ChatGPT Plus/Pro entitlement.

offers.title: Back to School 2026: four free Plus months (expired)
offers.benefit: Four free monthly billing periods of ChatGPT Plus
offers.eligibility: Eligible students verified under program rules; claim closed October 31, 2026.
offers.billing_note: Claim period ended October 31, 2026; previously redeemed trials may have a separate end date.

offers.title: India: 12 months ChatGPT Go free (ended 21 Jan 2026)
offers.benefit: 12 months of ChatGPT Go at no cost for eligible Indian customers
offers.eligibility: India-based new users, Free users or existing Go subscribers; one redemption per account; payment method required (card or UPI).
offers.billing_note: New redemptions ended January 21, 2026. Existing subscribers may still be within their redeemed 12-month term; confirm next charge in account.

offers.title: India: discounted ChatGPT Go continuation (account-specific)
offers.benefit: Account-specific reduced monthly price for three paid billing periods; not a second free year
offers.eligibility: Only recipients of the India Go 12-month trial who see a continuation offer in their own eligible ChatGPT account on web or Android.
offers.billing_note: Continuation offers are optional; after three discounted paid billing periods, the standard India Go monthly price applies unless cancelled. No public promo code.

offers.title: Vietnam ShopeeVIP: 3 months ChatGPT Go free (expired)
offers.benefit: Three free months of ChatGPT Go with eligible ShopeeVIP membership
offers.eligibility: Active ShopeeVIP, Vietnam (+84) ChatGPT account with no previous paid ChatGPT Go/Plus/Pro, valid international Visa/Mastercard; 600,000 claims limit.
offers.billing_note: Claim period April 13–May 31, 2026. Maintaining ShopeeVIP was required to keep full free period; ChatGPT Go renewal after trial was paid unless cancelled.

offers.title: Revolut Standard/Plus: 3 months ChatGPT Go free trial
offers.benefit: Three months ChatGPT Go free when invited and eligible through Revolut
offers.eligibility: Invited Revolut Standard/Plus customer aged 18+, resident in an eligible market, opted in to marketing where required, and no ChatGPT subscription in previous three months.
offers.billing_note: Offer period July 30, 2026–July 29, 2027; after trial ChatGPT Go auto-renews at the standard monthly price unless cancelled at least 24 hours before billing. Invitation is required.

offers.title: Revolut paid plan benefit: 6–12 months ChatGPT Go
offers.benefit: Premium/Pro/Mobile: 6 months; Metal: 12 months; Ultra: 12 months plus 12-month buddy pass
offers.eligibility: Eligible Revolut paid-plan customer; plan membership fees apply. Availability, one-time use and claim timing must be checked in the Revolut app.
offers.billing_note: This is a perk of paid Revolut plans, not a universally free standalone Go plan. Revolut app and plan terms govern availability; no public claim link.

offers.title: ChatGPT Free referral 2x usage limits (expired)
offers.benefit: Up to three 7-day awards doubling ChatGPT Free usage limits (21 days total)
offers.eligibility: Selected Free users with good-standing account at least 7 days old; qualifying new-user referrals in same country; not a paid subscription.
offers.billing_note: Program ended September 17, 2026. It increased ChatGPT Free usage limits, not Plus/Go rights; never a 12-month subscription.

offers.title: Telkomsel Indonesia: ChatGPT Go data bundle (expired)
offers.benefit: Paid Telkomsel bundle with ChatGPT Go access and data allowance (package dependent)
offers.eligibility: Eligible Telkomsel customers purchasing a qualifying data package and redeeming a partner voucher.
offers.billing_note: The original promotional bundle ran October 31, 2025–May 31, 2026; it was a paid telco bundle, not a universally free ChatGPT subscription.
